_comment: This directory is the git root, so this is the config pi-lens reads.
TurboMind builds CUDA for SM70 in a container. This host is macOS with no
CUDA toolkit and no compile_commands.json, so clangd resolves no include
and reports ~21 cascading errors per file, including untouched upstream
files. Real compilation runs via tools/v100/build_only.sh, which fails the
job on any compiler error, so C++ correctness is enforced there.
The disabled rules fire only on upstream Python style that predates this
work: asserts on tuple literals, a bare except, an identity comparison on
a literal, and unguarded calls in entry points. Pyright's implicit-Optional
findings are handled in pyrightconfig.json, where the interpreter is
already pinned. Everything else stays on.
